_comment: Contested quantities that must never appear as a single unqualified number. Seed data for R03. Each carries `context` terms: a bare number is only a finding when the surrounding text is actually about that quantity. Without this, 2,000 matches three different quantities at once and the rule becomes noise — and a noisy rule gets disabled, and a disabled rule guards nothing.

quantities.label: Spanish dead, Annual 1921
quantities.spread: definitional — whether Moroccan troops in Spanish service are counted, and whether the count runs to Monte Arruit or through the whole campaign

quantities.label: Casablanca 1907 civilian dead
quantities.spread: French estimates 600-1,500; German 2,000-3,000; Moroccan accounts higher

quantities.label: Casablanca massacre 1947 dead
quantities.spread: unresolved — a tenfold range, 180 to over 2,000

quantities.label: Rifian dead, 1958-59
quantities.spread: unresolved; c. 1,000 army dead is a separate figure

quantities.label: Zaian dead, El Herri 1914
quantities.spread: a French battlefield count made by the losing side; a floor, not a total. The 1991 Moroccan monument repeats the French figure rather than corroborating it.
